newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares close higher on end-month buying.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares close higher on end-month buying.

text.p: LISBON, Oct 31, Reuter - Portuguese shares rose to a firmer finish in brisk trade as investors rearranged portfolios for the end of the month. Markets are closed on Friday for All Saints' Day and dealers said Monday's trend would depend on how Wall Street ends tomorrow.
*PSI20 index finished 14.23 points higher at 4,774.04 on volume of six billion escudos.
*PSI20 November futures edged up to 4,789 from 4,787.
*Portugal Telecom (PT) dominated afternoon trade after a big foreign buy order boosted its price and volume. It closed up 45 esc at 3,980 with 423,016 shares traded.
*"We don't know why there was this sudden interest in PT," said one dealer. Others said it might simply have resulted from a rearrangement in portfolios.
*BFE gained 7 esc to end at 2,587 on volume of 323,789 as the bank's forthcoming takeover by BPI-SGPS stimulated trading interest.
*BESCL closed unchanged at 2,690 on turnover of 143,951.
